claim.statement: The publisher's current CLI cloud guide states that the openhands cloud command can authenticate to OpenHands Cloud or a custom server and create a hosted conversation from task text or a local file; the guide distinguishes cloud-hosted compute and cloud persistence from local CLI compute and local files.

source.title: OpenHands CLI Cloud guide
source.locator: Authentication; Creating Cloud Conversations; Cloud vs Local

limitations: This is rolling publisher documentation and is not silently applied to the exact 1.16.0 release.
The guide describes the location of compute and persistence at a high level; it is not a privacy, retention or security audit.
unknowns: The exact data uploaded from a task file, repository or configured integration is unknown.
Cloud retention, deletion, training, subprocess authority and network destinations were not established by the selected passages.
